zh.title: 國防部偵獲24架次中國軍機 其中17架次越臺海中線
zh.summary: 國防部通報偵獲24架次中國軍機，其中17架次越過臺灣海峽中線。
body: 國防部22日公佈的統計顯示，從前一天上午6時至22日上午6時的24小時內，共偵獲24架次中國軍機。其中17架次越過臺灣海峽中線，進入中部及西南空域。
同一統計期間也偵獲11艘中國軍艦及1艘公務船。國防部表示，國軍運用執行任務的軍機、軍艦及岸置飛彈系統，對相關動態進行嚴密監控並應處。
國防部另公佈2顆中國空飄氣球的動態，兩者均於前一天越過臺海中線。

en.title: Taiwan reports 24 Chinese military aircraft sorties; 17 cross the Taiwan Strait median line
en.summary: Taiwan's defense ministry detected 24 Chinese military aircraft sorties; 17 crossed the Taiwan Strait median line.
body: Taiwan's Ministry of National Defense said in a report on the 22nd that it detected 24 Chinese military aircraft sorties during the 24 hours ending at 6 a.m. that day. Of those, 17 crossed the Taiwan Strait median line into central and southwestern airspace.

The ministry also reported 11 Chinese naval vessels and one official vessel in the same period. It said the armed forces used mission aircraft and vessels, as well as shore-based missile systems, to closely monitor and respond to the activity.
Separately, the ministry reported that two Chinese airborne balloons crossed the Taiwan Strait median line the previous day.

sources.name: 中央社 CNA — 11艘共艦17架次共機擾台 國軍嚴密監控

facts.claim: The ministry's report on the 22nd covered the period from 6 a.m. the previous day to 6 a.m. that day.
facts.sourceQuote: （中央社記者 游凱翔 台北22日電）國防部發布共機艦動態，統計自昨天上午6時起至今天上午6時止

facts.claim: The ministry reported detecting 24 Chinese military aircraft sorties during the reporting period.
facts.sourceQuote: 國防部上午公布共機艦動態，統計自昨天上午6時起至今天上午6時止，偵獲11艘共艦、1艘公務船及24架次共機

facts.claim: Of the 24 sorties, 17 crossed the Taiwan Strait median line into central and southwestern airspace.
facts.sourceQuote: 24架次共機，其中17架次共機逾越台灣海峽中線侵擾中部、西南空域

facts.claim: The report recorded 11 Chinese naval vessels and one official vessel during the reporting period.
facts.sourceQuote: 統計自昨天上午6時起至今天上午6時止，偵獲11艘共艦、1艘公務船

facts.claim: The ministry said the armed forces used mission aircraft and vessels and shore-based missile systems to monitor and respond.
facts.sourceQuote: 國防部強調，國軍運用任務機艦及岸置飛彈系統嚴密監控與應處

facts.claim: The ministry reported two Chinese airborne balloons that crossed the Taiwan Strait median line the previous day.
facts.sourceQuote: 國防部也公布2顆中共空飄氣球動態。第1顆於昨天上午9時55分逾越台海中線，地點為基隆以西47浬、高度1萬2000呎，並於昨天上午11時25分消失；第2顆於昨天上午11時40分逾越台海中線
